references.text: Sisera's army with nine hundred iron chariots is mentioned here, which Barak pursues in verse 16.
Sisera gathered all his chariots at Harosheth-Haggoyim, the place where Barak pursued the enemy.
Deborah's song describes the same battle where the kings of Canaan were defeated at Megiddo.
Joshua struck down the enemy so that none survived, in the same way that Barak destroyed Sisera's army.
The Lord gave the enemy into Israel's hand, and they pursued them until none were left, just as Barak did.
The psalm mentions Sisera and Jabin who were annihilated at Endor, a reference to this battle.
Israel pursued the Philistines and struck them down, similar to the pursuit of Sisera's army.
Pharaoh's army was completely destroyed at the Red Sea; none were left, just like Sisera's army.
